pls_algorithm: kernel PLS (Dayal & MacGregor 1997) in numpy, reproducing sklearn PLSRegression (scale=True, sklearn sign rule and rotations)
memory_measure: psutil RSS sampled every 50 ms (peak above start); torch.mps.driver_allocated_memory for the GPU

gene_rule.name: V_clean
gene_rule.description: Standard gene list: top 50 genes by variance of log1p counts, after removing __ambiguous bins and rarely expressed genes. Computed per outer fold on training patients only.
gene_rule.detection_means: fraction of training spots with count > 0
gene_rule.rank_by: variance of log1p(count) across training spots (highest first)
gene_rule.computed_on: training patients of each outer fold (GroupKFold by patient, 4 folds)
